worldcombat.skill.toxicthread.summary: Spit a poisonous thread that wraps a foe, poisoning it and lowering its Speed; on a hit you may reel it in along the thread or pin it in place. The thread flies, so cover and footwork can dodge it. Only a body that can be moved is pulled in; one that resists takes the poison and the slow without being dragged.
worldcombat.skill.toxicthread.use.0: Get the drop on a fast target
worldcombat.skill.toxicthread.use.1: Reel a charging melee threat out of position
worldcombat.skill.toxicthread.use.2: Add a lasting poison to a stubborn foe
worldcombat.skill.toxicthread.descriptio: A target struck by the thread drops %1$s Speed stage(s) and is poisoned for %2$s; the Speed drop lasts until combat ends, and the poison deals damage over time. Poison-immune targets are not poisoned but still lose Speed and are still caught by the thread.
With Reel a hit drags the target up to %1$s blocks toward you along the thread; with Pin it instead roots the target in place for %2$s.
The thread flies at %1$s blocks/tick with a %2$s-block hit radius over up to %3$s blocks; windup %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.toxicthread.reel.on: Reel: on a hit, drag the target toward you along the thread to break its position or pull it into melee. A body that resists the pull (a high-resistance boss, for instance) only takes the poison and the slow; the thread goes slack instead of dragging it.
worldcombat.skill.toxicthread.reel.off: Pin: on a hit, freeze the target where it stands to hold it and open distance.
worldcombat.skill.toxicthread.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.toxicthread.preference: On drags the target toward you along the thread, good for pulling it into melee or breaking its position; off pins it in place to hold it and open distance. Neither changes the poison or the Speed drop.
The companion only considers spitting while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it at point-blank, larger starts sooner.
When on, the companion may leave its post to spit under a Hold order.
world_combat.move.toxicthread.text.noslo: The thread caught it but drew no Speed
world_combat.move.toxicthread.text.immun: Poison had no effect, but the thread still caught it
worldcombat.skill.toxicthread.descriptio: The thread is a projectile: terrain in its path blocks it, and a miss only leaves a small splash of venom with no effect.
A caught target carries a Laced mark for as long as the poison lasts; the mark itself adds no damage or slow, and the companion will not spit at an already-laced target again.
